title: 永夜行囊｜場景與怪物驗證 Round 03
direction: 04 粗線卡通主體＋C 花葉裝飾介面
preferenceEvidence: 使用者最喜歡 04，表示第二輪細節差異不明顯，但喜歡 C 的花紋；同意製作不同場景與怪物樣本。
scope: 僅為美術風格驗證，未確認新增遊戲關卡或敵人。

variants.name: 礦坑 × 哥布林
variants.tag: 暖色礦燈 · 岩壁 · 小型敵人
variants.description: 以礦坑、木支架與礦車取代森林；小型哥布林測試不同輪廓是否仍然醒目。
variants.tradeoff: 觀察暗處的主角與狼是否清楚，以及暖色岩壁會不會搶過敵人。
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game art direction validation.
Edit the provided reference into ONE full-screen portrait mobile fantasy game screenshot concept, same 9:16 proportions. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user selected its bold cartoon characters and gold botanical ornamental UI. Preserve that unified art style.
CHANGE ONLY THE BATTLE ENVIRONMENT AND THE ENEMY in the upper battle area, between the status HUD and the inventory title. Keep all other parts visually identical to image 1.
LOCKED ELEMENTS:
The same green-hooded brown-haired compact adventurer, exact same face, backpack, sword, pose, body proportions, location and scale on the LEFT. The same chunky gray wolf beside them with identical expression, silhouette, coat colors, stance, size and location. Keep their bold dark outlines, vivid flat colors and simple broad shadows. Only very subtle scene-colored rim light is allowed; do not redesign them or their clothes.
The entire inventory, its leather surround, gold leaf/vine filigree, ornate status HUD and three buttons are UNCHANGED, same materials, shapes, colors and positions. Retain all six item designs and their exact locations. Grid is 4 rows by 5 columns: sword col1 rows1-2, bow col2 rows1-3, purple-crystal staff col3 rows1-3, leather armor cols4-5 rows1-2, round shield cols4-5 rows3-4, green gemstone ring col1 row4. Keep the three empty cells. No additional items, objects or slot changes.
Preserve all original text exactly: "LV 5", "1-3", "84/100", "背包", "整理", "寵物", "合成". The pet button's paw icon and all botanical corner ornaments stay in place. No new text, scenery labels, titles, watermarks or phone frame.
NEW BATTLE PANEL RULES:
Side-view playable horizontal ground plane at the SAME height as the reference. Hero and wolf on left facing one new enemy on right; no other creatures or people. Create an unmistakably different location and enemy, not a recolor of the forest. Match the same polished Western cartoon thick contour lines, chunky expressive shapes, bold broad color blocks and clean 1-2 tone shadows. No realism, no pixel art, no anime, no painterly microtexture, no 3D. Enemy and background must look drawn by the same artist as the reference. Strong silhouettes at 390px screen width, do not hide the hero or wolf in scenery, and leave a clear gap between opposing sides. Upper background forms should be simplified and a little lighter/less contrasty than foreground figures. Preserve familiar cheerful-adventurous tone even in darker settings.
SCENE AND ENEMY:
A cozy-dangerous abandoned mine tunnel. Replace ALL forest trees and the outdoor arch with chunky dark violet and slate-blue rock walls, visibly angular overhead timber supports, a short cart rail receding into a side tunnel, one small parked ore cart in far background, a warm amber wall lantern and a few broad stylized turquoise crystal clusters. Keep path flat and unobstructed. Warm orange lantern light contrasts with cool purple rock shadows. No forest vegetation inside the tunnel.
Replace the skeleton with ONE distinctive cheeky green goblin miner on the right: very large pointed ears, big expressive amber eyes, broad nose, toothy mischievous grin, compact stocky body, rusty red leather miner cap, patched ochre leather vest, brown boots; holding one oversized pickaxe diagonally, ready to challenge the hero. Goblin is about 0.85 of the hero's height, with a wider chunky silhouette and thick dark outline; must remain very readable, not a tiny distant figure. Face it left. No skeleton remains. Keep the same character design language as the hero and wolf.

variants.name: 雪地遺跡 × 冰霜巨魔
variants.tag: 冷色雪光 · 大色塊 · 大型敵人
variants.description: 明亮雪地與藍色巨魔拉開冷暖對比，確認大型怪物和灰狼在淺色背景上的辨識度。
variants.tradeoff: 觀察巨魔是否擠壓戰場，以及灰狼能否從白雪中清楚分離。

variants.name: 古堡 × 盔甲亡靈
variants.tag: 月光火把 · 紅色旗幟 · 盔甲輪廓
variants.description: 古堡走廊用月光與火把營造氣氛，盔甲亡靈測試金屬造型與花葉介面的搭配。
variants.tradeoff: 觀察偏暗場景的清楚程度，以及角色和場景是否仍屬於同一套卡通風格。
